propositions: A frozen, versioned corpus of plan-review results must be built by enumerating sidecars from multiple store roots, including deleted REVIEW_RESULT blobs recovered from git history, with schema filtering and metadata retention.

The reviewed material per sidecar must be reconstructed by replaying CREATE/EDIT events from tree and history up to sidecar timestamp, resolving child pins, and rebuilding PlanContext to match the exact conditions under which the fingerprint was originally computed.

Fingerprint verification must test against a ladder of legacy normalization candidates (matching attest._legacy_material_ok exactly) and mark rows verified if any candidate matches; unmatched rows fall back to SNAPSHOT description and are marked unverified.

The corpus builder must emit a deterministic manifest (sorted keys, stable row ordering) and compact JSONL corpus; two builds from identical store refs must produce byte-identical manifest content hashes.
The builder must make no LLM calls and require no network beyond local git fetch.
Verification coverage and per-candidate match breakdown must be reported in the manifest for use by downstream noise-floor analysis.
